story.summaryEn:
Thank you, Elah and Lexie. 💚
Elah and Lexie, admins of Lance Stroll Mexico, stopped by to surprise the team with gifts in celebration of Lance’s birthday.
Thank you for your continued support. It never goes unnoticed. 
#MexicoGP
detailZh:
谢谢，Elah和Lexie。💚
Elah和Lexie，斯特罗尔墨西哥站的管理员，前来给车队带来礼物，庆祝Lance的生日。
感谢你们的持续支持。这一切都永远不会被忽视。
#墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn:
Thank you, Elah and Lexie. 💚
Elah and Lexie, admins of Lance Stroll Mexico, stopped by to surprise the team with gifts in celebration of Lance’s birthday.
Thank you for your continued support. It never goes unnoticed. 
#MexicoGP
